title: wss: supportsEphemeralPush:false case needs motivation
description: The urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:websocket capability object has a single field: supportsEphemeralPush (Boolean). A server advertising this capability with supportsEphemeralPush:false is permitted but its purpose is unexplained. If a server does not support ephemeral push, why advertise the capability at all? Decision: either document the intended use case for the false value (e.g., capability negotiation signaling planned support, or distinguishing WebSocket-capable-but-not-ephemeral servers), or remove the false case and make capability presence imply support.
close_reason: Removed supportsEphemeralPush field entirely. Capability is now an empty object {}; presence implies support. Servers not supporting ephemeral push must not advertise the capability. Follows the JMAP idiom used by the main urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat session-level capability.
